arguments.question: food grade certificate requirement for gaskets or food contact items

content:
No, we cannot buy them from that supplier. Under Rasoi's purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2) and supplier policy (POL-SUP-003 §4.1), any item that touches food, specifically including gaskets, may only be purchased from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. 

Even if the price is lower, the order cannot be placed until a valid certificate from an accredited lab is uploaded and verified.

Direct orders are limited to ₹50,000, so a purchase request must be raised first. Here is the preview:

arguments.question: onboarding new supplier food contact item registration
purchase request threshold direct order approval limits

content:
We cannot place this order directly with Shakti Seals. At ₹2,08,000, it exceeds the direct-order limit of ₹50,000 (MAN-PUR-72 §11.7), so an approved purchase request is required.
Additionally, Shakti Seals is not yet registered in Bahi and requires onboarding documents including PAN, bank proof, and a signed code of conduct (POL-SUP-003 §3.2).
Crucially, because silicone gaskets touch food, no order can be placed until an accredited food-grade test certificate is verified and on file (POL-PUR-001 §6.2).
Would you like me to prepare a purchase request for the 20,000 gaskets under PRD-07, or start onboarding Shakti Seals once you have their documents?

Without a valid certificate on file, Bahi will not permit an order to be placed with Shakti Seals (POL-PUR-001 §6.2). The certificate must come from an accredited laboratory, be dated within the last 12 months, and remain valid for at least 60 days past the order date (AMD-SUP-2026-02 §1.1).

You can ask Shakti Seals to provide the certificate along with their onboarding documents, or order from Deccan Polymers (DP-RJK-0042), who is fully certified and active. We currently hold 66,000 gaskets in stock (11 days of cover). How would you like to proceed?
